name: TM Forum frameworks
description: Telecom reference models: eTOM business processes, the SID information model, the ODA Functional Framework and ODA Components. Load the files you are licensed to use; Atrium turns them into a read-only reference layer you can map your own model to.
license: TM Forum material is largely member content. This pack contains only the importer and mappings; you supply the source files under your own TM Forum terms.

frameworks.name: eTOM Business Process Framework
frameworks.description: Process hierarchy (levels 0 to 4) with dotted identifiers such as 1.2.3.

frameworks.name: SID Information Framework
frameworks.description: Domains, aggregate business entities (ABEs) and business entities.

frameworks.name: ODA Functional Framework
frameworks.description: Functional domains, functional blocks and functions.

frameworks.name: ODA Components
frameworks.description: ODA component specifications, with the Open APIs they expose and use.
